summary: Completed backend and mobile browser regression testing. Public lessons, auth cookies/session rotation/logout, admin login, forwarded-IP lockout, reset/change-password, quiz idempotency, progress, responsive UI, manifest, and active service worker all passed.
seed_data_creation: Created uniquely named temporary learner accounts during API regression; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 passes all requested backend and frontend flows. No APIs were mocked. Mobile browser verified lesson navigation, unauthenticated quiz redirect, admin login, dashboard, manifest/service-worker registration and active controller.
rca of the issue: Previous forwarded-IP lockout defect is resolved: login now derives the lockout identifier from the first x-forwarded-for address, with request.client.host fallback. Five invalid attempts followed by a valid attempt returned 429 in the live regression suite.
